title: POV: EVERY DOOR
IN THIS HOTEL IS WEIRD
caption: Electro swing house at 124 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick with swung hi-hats, muted trumpet riffs, upright bass samples, ragtime piano stabs, door-knock percussion, playful theatrical female vocal like a cheeky hotel bellhop, call-and-response chorus with group shouts, clean modern mix
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Room one-oh-one, there's a llama in a suit
Room one-oh-two, seven cats are playing flute
Room one-oh-three, a ghost is baking bread
Room one-oh-four, a cactus doing yoga on the bed

[Chorus]
Knock knock, who's there? Open up the door
Every single room is crazier than before
Knock knock, who's there? Dancing down the hall
Hotel Knock Knock, we got it all

[Verse 2]
Room two-oh-one, grandpa on a trampoline
Room two-oh-two, a shark in a submarine
Room two-oh-three, a dino with a cake
Room two-oh-four, the disco makes the whole room shake

[Chorus]
Knock knock, who's there? Open up the door
Every single room is crazier than before
Knock knock, who's there? Dancing down the hall
Hotel Knock Knock, we got it all

[Outro - instrumental]
